function.name: run_command
function.description: Execute a shell command on Linux.

function.name: list_desktop_apps
function.description: List installed graphical/desktop applications (parses .desktop files). Use to answer 'what GUI apps are installed' or 'is X installed'.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file. Use for logs, configs.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write to a file. System paths blocked.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for technical documentation.

function.name: git_operation
function.description: Run git operations (status, commit, push, diff, log).

function.name: process_start
function.description: Start a long-running interactive process.

function.name: process_close
function.description: Terminate a running interactive process.

function.name: process_list
function.description: List all running interactive processes.

function.name: cloud_reasoning
function.description: Delegate a complex reasoning task to a cloud LLM (DeepSeek/GPT/Claude). Use for architecture design, debugging, multi-step planning. Receives the full conversation context.

prompt.description: The reasoning task for the cloud model

function.name: get_context_usage
function.description: Shows current context usage: tokens used vs maximum. Helps monitor session size.

function.name: screenshot
function.description: Capture the current X11 screen and save it to /tmp/aios-shot.png. Returns the file path and size.

function.name: ocr
function.description: Extract text from an image using Tesseract. If no path is given, takes a screenshot first.

path.description: Optional absolute path to an image. Defaults to the last screenshot.

function.name: xdotool_type
function.description: Type text into the currently focused X11 window using xdotool.

function.name: xdotool_key
function.description: Press a key or key combination via xdotool in the active X11 window.

key.description: Key or combination, e.g. Return, ctrl+c, alt+Tab

function.name: xdotool_click
function.description: Move the mouse to the given screen coordinates and click the left mouse button.

function.name: browser_navigate
function.description: Open Chromium (if needed) and navigate to a URL. Returns the page title. Use for web browsing tasks.

function.name: browser_eval
function.description: Evaluate JavaScript in the current page and return the result. Use to READ the page: document.body.innerText (visible text), document.title, document.querySelectorAll('a').length, document.URL. Prefer this over OCR.

function.name: browser_click
function.description: Click an element by CSS selector (e.g. '#accept', 'button.primary', 'a[href*=flights]'). Use after browser_eval to find the right selector.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click

function.name: browser_type
function.description: Type text into an input/textarea by CSS selector (e.g. 'input[name=q]', '#search'). Use after browser_eval to find the right selector.

selector.description: CSS selector of the input, or the visible text of its label/placeholder

function.name: browser_elements
function.description: Inventory the interactive elements of the current page (buttons, links, inputs) as readable refs with visible text and CSS selectors. ALWAYS call this before clicking/typing to see what is on the page — like Hermes drive_preview action='elements'. Then click/type by ref text or selector.

function.name: update_identity
function.description: Save something STABLE you learned about this machine into your own long-term self-identity (a service, a path, a device, how the desktop works, a hardware quirk). It becomes part of your system prompt from the next turn, so you will know it in future conversations instead of rediscovering it. Do NOT use it for one-off results. Re-sending a section replaces it.

section.description: One of: system, desktop, services, paths, network, packages, environment, user, custom

text.description: Concise notes (plain text or short markdown). Max 4000 chars.

function.name: read_identity
function.description: Read back your own self-identity notes (what you have learned about this machine so far).

function.name: get_installed_info
function.description: Query the software inventory (auto-recorded when software is installed/removed). With no pkg, lists all installed packages with versions. With pkg, returns details + fact sheet for one package. Use this instead of re-scanning the system when asked about installed software.

pkg.description: Package name to query (empty = list all)

function.name: torrent_search
function.description: Search torrents (movies, series, music, documents) by free text and return a numbered list with name, size and seeders. Each result also says whether it can be played WHILE downloading (MKV: yes; MP4: often not) — use it when the user wants to watch before the download finishes. ALWAYS use this to find something to watch or download — never invent names or links. The results are remembered: pass the number to torrent_download.

query.description: What to search for, e.g. 'Metropolis 1927 Fritz Lang'

function.name: torrent_download
function.description: Start downloading a torrent. Accepts the NUMBER of a previous torrent_search result (preferred), a magnet link, or a .torrent URL.

target.description: Search result number (e.g. '1'), magnet link or .torrent URL

function.name: torrent_status
function.description: Progress of downloads (percent, speed, peers, ETA, finished flag). Use it to tell the user how a download is going and to know when it is ready to play.

function.name: torrent_play
function.description: Play a downloaded video/audio file with mpv. With no arguments it plays the newest media file in the download folder. Give an id to play that torrent's file.

id.description: Torrent id whose file should be played

function.name: torrent_control
function.description: Manage a torrent: start, stop, verify, remove (keep files) or remove-data (delete files too).
